products.name: Hairgrowth Oil
products.summary: Blended pure oils and essential oils for the scalp.
products.description: Our signature oil: a blend of pure oils and essential oils to massage into the scalp. It helps stimulate the follicles and reduce breakage, and seals moisture into the ends. Suits every hair type.
products.ingredients: Blended pure oils and essential oils.
products.usage: Part your hair into sections and massage a few drops into your scalp. Smooth what's left over the ends. Use two or three times a week.

products.name: Black African Shampoo
products.summary: A gentle wash made with black African soap.
products.description: Made with traditional black African soap and essential oils. It lifts away build-up while keeping your hair's natural oils in balance, and it's sulfate free.
products.ingredients: Black African soap and essential oils.
products.usage: Work into a wet scalp with your fingertips, let the lather run through the lengths, then rinse well.

products.name: Deep Conditioner
products.summary: A rich treatment of pure oils and essential oils.
products.description: An intensive treatment for dry, thirsty or chemically treated hair. It restores softness and shine, and makes detangling easier.
products.usage: Apply to damp hair from mid-length to ends. Cover with a cap for 15–30 minutes, then rinse with cool water.

products.name: Hairgrowth Moisturizer
products.summary: Shea butter, essential oils and herbs.
products.description: A creamy daily moisturiser of shea butter, essential oils and herbs. It softens and nourishes dry hair and helps strengthen strands against breakage and split ends.
products.ingredients: Shea butter, essential oils and herbs.
products.usage: Smooth a small amount through damp or dry hair, focusing on the ends. Follow with the Hairgrowth Oil to seal in moisture.
